content_data.meeting_title: Q4 Campaign Performance Review & Holiday Season Strategy Planning
agenda_items: Review streaming platform partnership campaign metrics and ROI analysis
Budget reallocation discussion for underperforming digital channels
Competitive analysis of rival studios' promotional tactics
Discuss brand positioning adjustments for upcoming content releases
key_decisions: Postpone podcast advertising campaign until after holiday season to optimize spend efficiency
Shift 15% of display advertising budget to TikTok and Instagram Reels for younger demographic targeting
Greenlight partnership with three mid-tier gaming influencers for cross-platform content promotion

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: The agenda included reviewing streaming platform partnership campaign metrics and ROI analysis, budget reallocation for underperforming digital channels, competitive analysis of rival studios' promotional tactics, and discussing brand positioning adjustments for upcoming content releases.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: We decided to postpone the podcast advertising campaign, shift 15% of the display advertising budget to TikTok and Instagram Reels, and greenlight a partnership with three mid-tier gaming influencers.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: The attendees included Nadia Okafor, our Social Media Manager; Leila Al-Farsi, Brand Strategy Director; Chen Wei, Marketing Analytics Manager; and Marcus Johnson, Digital Marketing Lead.
